title: UI Dashboard wiring — add ghost-decisions, explain, handoff sections to code.html
acceptance_criteria: New nav item 'Awareness' added to dashboard navigation
Ghost Decisions panel: fetches GET /api/memory/{project}/ghost-decisions, renders ghost list with severity indicators
Explain panel: text input for 'why' question, calls POST /api/memory/{project}/explain, renders causal chain + citations
Handoff panel: role selector dropdown, token budget input, calls POST /api/memory/{project}/handoff, renders packet preview
All panels follow existing glass-panel + accent-lavender styling
Responsive at breakpoints: mobile (<640px), tablet (640-1024px), desktop (>1024px)
Follows 4-stage design workflow (layout → theme → animation → implementation)
Fetch calls use same pattern as existing dashboard sections
